name: Laura Clarke
title: Medicare Clinical Psychologist Provider
description: I'm a Clinical Psychologist based in Melbourne/Naarm, offering Telehealth therapy for adults across Australia. I have experience working in private, public, NGO, and university psychology settings, including lecturing and supporting postgraduate clinical placements. My approach is warm, collaborative, and trauma-informed, integrating CBT, ACT, and psychodynamic therapy with a focus on emotions, attachment patterns, and insight to support meaningful, longer-term change.

description: Claire enjoys providing an environment where clients can feel comfortable to share their experiences. name: Prof Gemma Sharp
title: Medicare Clinical Psychologist Provider
description: *Limited availability for new clients via telehealth in Australia only* Prof Gemma Sharp is a clinical psychologist whose therapeutic approach is warm, empathetic and non-judgemental. She is committed to helping clients gain an understanding of their challenges and develop new skills so they can lead fulfilling lives. Gemma works with adults of all ages experiencing a range of health and psychological issues including eating disorders, body image issues, body dysmorphic disorder, trauma and PTSD, personality disorders, depression, anxiety, OCD, perfectionism, grief and loss, women's health, and relationship issues. She utilises a range of evidence-based therapies including Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (CBT), Enhanced Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (CBT-E) for eating disorders, Cognitive Processing Therapy, Eye Movement Desensitisation and Reprocessing (EMDR) Therapy, Schema Therapy, Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT), and Dialectical Behavioural Therapy (DBT) principles.
specialties: Diverse genders, Gender Dysphoria, Sexual abuse, Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Diverse sexualities, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), EMDR, Schema Therapy

name: Rose Pearton
title: Medicare Clinical Psychologist Provider
description: I am a clinical psychologist practicing in Melbourne, Australia. I have experience working with young people and adults in public and private mental health settings. I am LGBTIQA+ inclusive and sex worker friendly and passionate about inclusive care and client centred approaches. I utilise CBT, ACT, schema therapy and DBT to help my clients reduce distress and increase meaning, enjoyment and functioning in their lives.
specialties: Diverse genders, Gender Dysphoria, Diverse sexualities, Sex worker issues, Schema Therapy

name: Dr Prasanthi Venugopalan

I work with clients experiencing a wide range of mental health issues (including anxiety, depression, stress, and motivational difficulties), as well as coping difficulties related to identity and adjustment, loneliness, and other challenges.
